def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    # turn toward enemy
    bearing = me.bearing_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
    # proportional turn, limited to [-1,1]
    turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, bearing / 45.0))
    # forward speed: faster when roughly aligned
    forward = 0.8 if abs(bearing) < 30 else 0.4
    left = forward + turn
    right = forward - turn
    left = max(-1.0, min(1.0, left))
    right = max(-1.0, min(1.0, right))
    return (left, right)

def weapons(me, enemy, arena):
    # spin up the front horizontal spinner once
    if not me.memory.get("spun_up", False):
        me.memory["spun_up"] = True
        return spin("front", 5000)
    return None

def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    # target enemy
    bearing = bearing_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
    # avoid wall: if near boundary, steer toward center
    dist_center = (me.x**2 + me.y**2)**0.5
    wall_bearing = bearing_to(0,0)
    # blend
    if dist_center > 5.5:
        # steer toward center more
        turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, wall_bearing/30.0))
    else:
        turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, bearing/30.0))
    forward = 1.0
    left = max(-1.0, min(1.0, forward + turn))
    right = max(-1.0, min(1.0, forward - turn))
    return (left, right)

def weapons(me, enemy, arena):
    if not me.memory.get("spun_up", False):
        me.memory["spun_up"] = True
        return spin("front", 5000)
    return spin("front", 5000)
